dedupe_keys.name: grasshopper script for automatically generated highly flexible external louvred shading devices

description: This Grasshopper script generates flexible external louvred shading geometry for building daylight and thermal co-simulation. The native description specifies adjustable lamella width, thickness, vertical position and tilt, including collision-avoidance intervals. Generated geometry connects to Honeybee and Ladybug components for Daysim daylight analysis and EnergyPlus thermal modelling, with custom reflectance settings passed to the latter. Zenodo supplies one GH file freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a generic window-shading geometry workflow, without a fixed building location or simulation period. The source states full-scale experimental validation but provides no accuracy metrics in the inspected description. Related façade models address separate envelope systems. A limitation is that host software versions and external dependency licences are unspecified. The GH file was not downloaded or executed, and the stated co-simulation connections were not tested.
